accessToken.description: Optional current opaque WhaleU access token. Public guest reads are allowed, but a supplied invalid, expired, revoked, or restricted credential never silently downgrades to guest. Campus selection grants no affiliation, UID, or administrative authority.

info.description: Current accepted physical-campus catalogs, exact catalog-bound details and copy/webview actions, and dedicated immutable Media reads. Missing evidence is distinct from known-empty and not-applicable. Production source, location, and embedded-platform activation remain separate gates; no historical source is seeded.
info.title: WhaleU accepted campus tools

get.description: Current accepted physical-campus tools. Guest browse never downgrades a supplied invalid credential. No historic source is seeded.
Explicit exact current catalog action. Copy authority never grants webview embedding. No arbitrary destination parameter.
Dedicated campus-tools owner, exact immutable measured variant, current authority before and after storage; no raw URL.
